bioghist.head: Historical Information
bioghist.p: The Virginia Research Investment Committee (VRIC) and Virginia Research Investment Fund (VRIF) were created by the General Assembly in 2016 to foster economic development and job creation through competitive grants that supported innovative and collaborative research, development and commercialization projects and programs by institutions of higher education and the private sector. The State Council of Higher Education in Virginia administered the Virginia Research Investment Fund, which was overseen by the Virginia Research Investment Committee. Both the VRIC and VRIF were repealed by the General Assembly in 2020, and the Virginia Innovative Partnership Authority was created to carry on the mission of these two entities.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Minutes, 2016-2020, document the meetings, activities, discussions, policy decisions and recommendations of the Virginia Research Investment Committee. Records include minutes, agendas, presentations, reports and other committee documentation, such as bylaws, correspondence, studies, summaries and updates. Also includes Annual Reports to the General Assembly, 2016-2020; Commonwealth Research and Technology Strategic Roadmap, 2019; Report on Research and Development Inventory Effort in the Commonwealth, 2020; and Assessment of Virginia's Research Assets, 2018. Files are foldered and arranged chronologically by meeting date, with a final folder that includes various reports.
